column2: I do not think $$ベルフェ$$'s methods were entirely right, but...
Surely this city will change too, for better or worse...
Thank you very much. You told them to save me, did you not!?
No, to begin with, you were captured because of us...
But I no longer have a home...
Please take me along as your $$奴隷$$, Sir Knight!?
Wha, no!! It is too dangerous for you to travel with us!
Hey, do not cry... What am I supposed to do...?
Why do you not protect her with that ridiculous strength of yours!?
It cannot be helped... Well, I can take you along—not as a $$奴隷$$, but as a companion.
